segments.sensitive: Many reviewers with sensitive, reactive or rosacea-prone skin report tolerating the serum well with little to no irritation, though a couple with sensitive skin report burning, redness or bumps, especially with frequent use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report improved hydration, softness and reduced acne alongside anti-aging effects, and it is generally described as gentle even on very dry or eczema-prone skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin and enlarged pores reports it was irritating: her skin went into sebum overdrive and felt sunburn-tight after nighttime use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin, whose skin breaks out easily, reports clearer, brighter skin with regular use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for fine lines and wrinkles report visible fading of crow's feet, smoother texture and firmer-looking skin over weeks of use, though one reviewer used it for two months with no noticeable difference to age spots or overall skin.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with long-standing hormonal or teenage acne, report significant clearing of breakouts, but one reviewer describes it as ruining her skin, triggering cystic pimples and ongoing irritation for months after use.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report reduced redness and no irritation, but one reviewer's skin became red and bumpy with burning after just three days of use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading of sun spots, dark spots and hyperpigmentation with consistent use, including on skin described as having non-cancerous sun damage.

aspects.libelle: Can trigger an initial purge or retinization rash before improving
Needs a gradual introduction, easing in every other night at first
Has a light citrus or floral scent rather than being fragrance-free
Gentler than prescription retinoids reviewers had tried before
Dropper bottle makes it easy to control the amount used

extraits.texte: I used this serum as directed for two full months with absolutely NO difference to some age spots on my face. I also saw no difference to my skin in general. But I think people have a lot of wishful thinking when it comes to products like this. I was already using good serums, so I didn't expect to see any differences except on that promise about fixing discolorations. And it failed on that.

I got the vitamin a serum and used it for 3 days, it burned my skin, I had red bumped over my cheeks and forehead. I had to return it and Ulta was very helpful with return process. They recommended derma d vitamin c intense night cream and in a week it cleared my skin from the red bumps. I'm 35 years old I have normal/dry skin.

extraits.titre: Wanted to love but ruined my skin
extraits.texte: I have struggled with hormonal acne for years now, but nothing besides some returning pimples that, looking back, were more of annoyance if anything. Having LOVED Mad Hippie's Vitamin C serum and recieving a sample of this Vitamin A serum within my package, I figured I'd give it a shot and see if this would be the miracle product the reviews claimed to be. Oh my, was I wrong. To be frank, I had experimented with the DHC cleansing oil a month prior which had given me horrible cystic pimples and a messed up barrier. I applied this serum every other night, alternating with The Ordinary Niacinamide serum on my "off" days. The first night I had a beautiful glow and my pimples seemed smaller. Every use after furthered a nightmare of my own design. My skin is so messed up even 4 months later; I cant use any actives (even my old products that never caused me ant issues) without my skin burning, becoming red and inflamed, or breaking out in terrible little whiteheads and even MORE cystic pimples on my jaw! The left side of my face is now covered in rough, bumpy skin that refuses to smooth over. I had high hopes for my first retinoid seeing as I had experince with AHA/BHAs, and that this formula was supposed to be gentle enough for people like me. So disappointing and I really miss the way my skin was before I used this serum. Buy at your own risk.

So I just started using this for about 1 week. I know everyone says this but when I say I have sensitive skin I mean the kind of skin that if you touch it with a finger it becomes red, blotchy, then basically shrivels up, dies, and flakes off. I'm not exaggerating. That being said, I have to be very very careful what I use on my skin. I began using this as instructed (every other night) and making sure to wait the ten minutes to apply my night cream. My skin is so clear and without redness that I'm alarmed. Should my skin look like this? Where is my rosacea ? What about my flakes on my forehead ? And did I mention that dark spots/post acne hyperpigmentation are starting to go away ? I'm floored. I'm hoping my skin doesn't start to react badly so here's to hoping.

extraits.titre: Sun spots fading, fine lines disappearing
extraits.texte: I am over 40 and have non cancerous sun damage that is rough to the touch. Dermatologists freeze it off but it never fully smooths and always comes right back. I've been using this Vitamin A serum for about a month now, and have been loving the results. The sun damage on my face is smoothing out, and my complexion is becoming more balanced. Bothersome fine lines around my mouth and chin are smoothing out. Follow the directions - it does take the skin some getting used to at first. I have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: really helped with my acne and dull skin
extraits.texte: I'm in my thirties with very dry skin, have had acne since my early teens. I tried the AHA glycolic acid serum first, which made my skin pretty soft but didn't resolve my acne. I saw an immediate difference when I switched to the Super A serum. I started with every other night and now apply every night along with a salicylic acid gel. My acne has decreased significantly and my skin tone is more even and bright. Over the years I've tried Proactiv, Curology, and various natural remedies for acne but this is the one that's working for me now as my skin ages.

I am 44 and have difficult skin. Dry and sensitive with rosacea; prone to acne, and hyperpigmentation. I have also failed prescription topical retinoids at least 3 times, and thus had given up hope for the last 10 years that I would ever be able to use ANY kind of topical retinoid. Fast forward to now. I have been using the Super A serum for the last 20 days, sandwiched between a lightweight and heavier weight moisturizer, every evening. AND I AM BLOWN AWAY. The acne and congestion on my chin that has been a permanent fixture of my skin for as long as I can remember is virtually GONE. Up and vanished. Upon initiation I did have ONE "purge" which resulted in a very nasty cyst on my chin that took >2 weeks to resolve. But I pushed through and now it's in the clear and my skin has never looked better. I am looking forward to seeing what more this serum has in store. Updating at the 1 month point: I am gobsmacked. My skin is virtually flawless. To think, all this time, this serum was what I needed? It's a miracle.
